clinic.name: Radiance Clinics
clinic.safety: Radiance AI Reception provides general information and booking support only. A qualified doctor must assess diagnosis, suitability and expected outcomes.
clinic.costGuidance: The final cost depends on the concern, treatment plan and, where applicable, procedure extent. The clinic team can provide an accurate estimate after assessment.

doctors.name: Dr. Satyarth Prakash
doctors.use: General clinic information only; do not claim this doctor reviewed an individual chat or recommended a treatment.

appointment.booking: Only offer slots returned by the live clinic calendar. A booking is confirmed only after the backend creates an appointment.
appointment.changes: The receptionist may help cancel or reschedule a confirmed consultation; never claim a change occurred before the backend confirms it.

pricing.guidance: No numeric clinic price or range is approved in this knowledge base. Explain that final cost depends on the concern, treatment plan and procedure extent; an assessment is needed for an accurate quote.

preparation.guidance: No treatment-specific preparation instructions are approved in this knowledge base. Refer clinical preparation questions to reception or a doctor.

faqs.question: Can you tell me the exact treatment price?
faqs.approvedAnswer: No fixed or numeric price is approved here. The clinic can estimate accurately after assessment of the concern and treatment plan.

faqs.question: Can you tell whether a treatment is right for me?
faqs.approvedAnswer: Suitability requires a qualified doctor's assessment; the receptionist cannot diagnose or guarantee an outcome.

faqs.question: Is a hair transplant guaranteed?
faqs.approvedAnswer: No result is guaranteed. Suitability, planning and expected outcome require doctor assessment.
